|game_text=Deploy on [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]]. During battle, opponent may not move from here. Once per battle, may target a character (target loses immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]. Other errata versions: [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-169-Luke_s_Blaster_Pistol-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip shows the original text (see [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]); the Players Committee card image shows the PC-E2 text (see [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. Twice per battle, may target a character (target loses immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “Twice per battle” to “Once per battle”: “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. Once per battle, may target a character (target loses immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.”.<ref name="cl-1220_169-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]): Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata) changed “Once per battle, may” to “May” and “loses immunity” to “loses any immunity”: “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. May target a character (target loses any immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.”.<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-14; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announcement date not found). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> Also in the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013), whose slip carries the errata mark E.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
